rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Notification is a 0.56 ha regeneration felling (Föryngringsavverkning) in Leksand, status notified.
No completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).

No eligible species within 250 m. The only red-listed records there are mobile birds (Nucifraga caryocatactes, NT, 2016) and a plant (Hypochaeris maculata, NT, 2022) that the tool marks as not felling-relevant.

Two eligible species lie beyond 250 m but within 1000 m: Pulsatilla vernalis (EN, 601 m, 2019) and Goodyera repens (VU, 719 m, latest 2025). Both are site-bound, forest-associated and felling-relevant. This gives the rubric MEDIUM.

Near-site effort is adequate: 30 records and 29 species within 250 m, and the 1000 m record count is at the 82nd county percentile. The absence of eligible records within 250 m is therefore more informative than at a poorly surveyed site, but it is not proof of absence.

uncertainties: The records at 601 m and 719 m are not on the site, and the tools do not show whether the stand is similar habitat.
The Pulsatilla vernalis record is from 2019.
Seven records were dropped for coordinate uncertainty, so some nearby records may be missing.
not_established: That any threatened species occupies the polygon.
That the site has no species of conservation interest. Absence of records is not absence of species.
Any biodiversity measurement, or whether the felling is legal.
next_action: A reviewer should check the stand for habitat that could suit Pulsatilla vernalis and Goodyera repens, given the nearby records at 601 m and 719 m, before the felling window opens.
